methodology.annual_completeness: Annual values require all 12 valid monthly observations; NASA's YYYY13 value is never used.
methodology.significance_basis: Hamed-Rao corrected p-value (lag limited to 3); the original Mann-Kendall p-value is reported alongside.
methodology.confidence_interval: Conventional 95% Theil-Sen confidence interval (Sen 1968, as implemented in scipy.stats.theilslopes). It is NOT adjusted for autocorrelation and may be too narrow for serially correlated data.
methodology.seasonal: Hirsch-Slack seasonal Mann-Kendall with period 12; not autocorrelation-adjusted.
methodology.baseline: 1991-2020 when each calendar month has >= 24 valid observations, otherwise a labelled custom reference period.
limitations: Reanalysis grid-cell data (~50 km), not station observations.
Mann-Kendall detects monotonic trends; non-significance does not prove stability.
Hamed-Rao treats retained values as consecutive; excluded years create gaps.
Seasonal test ignores correlation between calendar months.

annual.method: Day-weighted mean of 12 monthly mean temperatures (leap years respected); years with fewer than 12 valid months are excluded.

annual_trend.ci95_note: Conventional 95% Theil-Sen confidence interval (Sen 1968, as implemented in scipy.stats.theilslopes). It is NOT adjusted for autocorrelation and may be too narrow for serially correlated data.
annual_trend.interpretation: Statistically significant increasing monotonic trend at alpha=0.05 (Hamed-Rao corrected p=2.112e-12); Sen's slope +0.2 degC/decade.

seasonal_trend.method: Hirsch-Slack seasonal Mann-Kendall, period=12 (within-month comparisons only)
seasonal_trend.interpretation: Statistically significant increasing seasonal trend at alpha=0.05 (p=9.88e-143; not corrected for autocorrelation); seasonal Sen's slope +0.2 degC/decade.

month_wise_trends.note: Exploratory: twelve separate tests. Prefer the Holm-adjusted p-values; unadjusted per-month significance is likely to include false positives.
month_wise_trends.correction: Holm-Bonferroni across the 12 calendar months, applied to Hamed-Rao p-values

baseline.note: Reference period 1991-2020 (the current standard WMO reference period), computed from NASA POWER MERRA-2 grid data; not an official station-based WMO normal.

anomalies.note: Anomaly = monthly value minus the normal of the same calendar month over the reference period.

annual.method: Monthly total (mm) = mean daily rate (mm/day) x days in month; annual total (mm/year) = sum of monthly totals; annual mean rate (mm/day) = annual total / days in year. Years with fewer than 12 valid months are excluded.

annual_total_trend.ci95_note: Conventional 95% Theil-Sen confidence interval (Sen 1968, as implemented in scipy.stats.theilslopes). It is NOT adjusted for autocorrelation and may be too narrow for serially correlated data.
annual_total_trend.interpretation: Statistically significant decreasing monotonic trend at alpha=0.05 (Hamed-Rao corrected p=2.536e-06); Sen's slope -40 mm/decade.

seasonal_trend.method: Hirsch-Slack seasonal Mann-Kendall, period=12 (within-month comparisons only)
seasonal_trend.interpretation: Statistically significant decreasing seasonal trend at alpha=0.05 (p=2.104e-24; not corrected for autocorrelation); seasonal Sen's slope -0.11 mm/day/decade.

month_wise_trends.note: Exploratory: twelve separate tests. Prefer the Holm-adjusted p-values; unadjusted per-month significance is likely to include false positives.
month_wise_trends.correction: Holm-Bonferroni across the 12 calendar months, applied to Hamed-Rao p-values
